title.title: Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties
title.subtitle: Claim: after good reduction, a Hodge class pairs to one rational number in every cohomology theory

object.heading: One Hodge class $\gamma$, paired with divisors $D_1 \cdots D_{d-r}$ on the reduction

beats.text: Each theory, $\ell$-adic for $\ell \ne p$ or crystalline, computes the pairing on its own
The claim: all of them give the same rational number $q$, even when $p = 2$
The cycle corollary leans on family 032, unrefereed and without Lean

plain: Several 'rulers' measure the same hidden piece of a shape; the claim is they all read the same fraction

steps: Start from any Hodge class on the reduced shape
Move it to one pulled back from a special, symmetric CM variety
There the pairing can be computed, and it is a fraction

boxes: pulled back from a CM variety
